_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
I ni Joueur {player_id} ye Tic Tac Toe la.
Jɛɛli ni kɛ i ko sɔrɔ saba kɛnɛ kan (tɛnɛ, ɲɛfɔ, walima kɔlɔn) tabali la.
I ka tɛmɛn, i bɛna bɔ kɔgɔ dɔ la (0-8) i bɛna sɔrɔ i ka sɛbɛnɛ kɔfɛ.
Kɔrɔ, '[4]' bɛna sɔrɔ i ka sɛbɛnɛ tabali kɔgɔ la.
Ni Joueur {player_id} ye, i bɛna '{symbol}' ye, walima i ka jɛɛli '{opponent_symbol}' ye.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O labɛn in ma tugu sariya sɛbɛ la.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} tɛ sɛli jɛlen ye. A ka kan ka kɛ 0 ani 8 cɛ.

game_action.placed: Jɛkulu {player_id} yan jɛkulu ye sɛbɛn ({symbol}) kɔnɔntɛ kɛlɛn {cell}.
